Kento and Rowen meet up in the subway and search for the others while Talpa enacts a plan to turn the heroes to evil based on his knowledge of their armors' dark origins.

Despite Anubis' previous failure to follow Talpa's orders, Talpa dispatches him to an amusement park where the heroes have gathered; Kento tries to fight without his armor, fearing that using it will turn him against his friends.
The Ancient One reveals the nature of the mystical armors and their relationship to good and evil; as Anubis rethinks his loyalty to Talpa, Talpa's other warlords launch an attack.
The Ancient One helps the heroes reach Talpa's castle and the team faces the combined might of the dark forces in an attempt to break through and face Talpa himself.
Talpa easily defeats Ryo and integrates his warlords' armors into his own form, directly attacking the heroes to steal their armors for himself.
With the powers of all the other armors at his command, Talpa confronts Ryo, the only remaining warrior, who must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.

The Barracuda finally arrives in Industria and Conan and Jimsy are stunned to find it bleak and deserted; Conan races through the complex searching for Lana.
Conan and Lana are finally reunited but the villainous Lepka continues to pursue them; shocked by Lepka's brutality, Captain Dyce's allegiances begin to shift.
Dyce leaves Conan trapped in an Industria holding cell and escapes with Lana to the Barracuda; he finds cover in a dense fog but Lepka is close behind.
With Lepka's gunboat in pursuit, Lana uses a lifeboat to rescue Conan from the open sea.
As they navigate a vast desert, Conan and Lana are discovered by a salvage ship captain named Patch.
Earthquakes rattle Industria as Lepka continues his search for Lana's grandfather Dr. Lao.

A mysterious hacker has taken over an AI-controlled office building and turned its security systems against the people inside; Sengoku is forced to try and save the hostages and find the hacker - or die trying.
Gogul tries to help his old flame and former partner in crime outsmart the military's ultimate killing machine.
Geneticists around the city are dying from what looks like vampire bites; the case falls to pretty-boy Benten.

In a future with household robots, two high school boys find a café where humans and robots mingle anonymously. As they explore this unique space, they uncover surprising truths about robots, humanity and themselves.
The Science Patrol gets word that the stellar radiation emitted by a comet as it roars past the Earth may accidentally cause hydrogen bombs to explode.
Investigators visit ancient ruins on Tamara Island, and spot Monster Dolfiego in an underground cavern.
A famous magician, George Satake, tries to teleport himself from the Xalome Desert to Japan.
Choichiro Hikari, a member of the monster-fighting team Scientific Defense Guard, joins forces with Ultraman Jonias to save Earth from looming danger.
Two tankers are caught in a storm and disappear; the Science Guard Party take the case, and discover three monsters attacking the tankers.
At Lake Ryujin in Tohoku, an incident breaks out where people and fish are being turned into stone.
An unidentified celestial body approaches Earth and emits radiation that makes reptiles violent.
During a New Year's celebration, Dr. Elephant presents Uran; Uran gets involved with a villain who kidnaps robot children.

The Donohues and the Cavalets have been enemies for generations; their racing teams are rivals and their robot brothers are opposed to each other; Robio of the Donohues and Robiette of the Cavalets fall in love; Astro participates in the race.
While on school field trip to a comet, Astro Boy and classmates are kidnapped by Atlas.
Atlas, who has been released from ice by Vivian, causes a subway train to go out of control to lure Astro out and challenge him.
